levels: first observed failure or component hard limit
sweep_policy.physical_rating_rule: Every accepted operating profile must satisfy the weakest modeled and physically qualified limit. An internal RTL limit cannot authorize a drive timing or current rating.

required: exact MPN and source pin binding
corners.values: Unspecified ranges remain missing requirements/model inputs; do not silently use generic 12/24 V or -40/+85 C assumptions.
corners.monte_carlo: Declare distributions, correlations, seeds and sample counts; Monte Carlo does not replace worst-case extrema.

subsystems.name: Twelve simultaneous STEP/DIR generators
subsystems.required_method: Twelve actual unchanged cnc_stepgen instances: fixed positive/negative segments, all emitted-edge/count comparisons, pulse high/low, safe DDS boundary and first adversarial failure
subsystems.remaining_engineering: Actual complete CNC3 endpoint, per-channel configured timing/polarity, changing velocities/reversals, driver/cable/load corners and vendor timing remain unqualified

subsystems.name: Four base ABZ paths, expansion toward twelve
subsystems.required_method: Sweep full receiver/filter/synchronizer/counter chain by quadrature EDGE rate, both directions, duty/phase extremes, Z gating, illegal transitions, unplug and noisy inputs
subsystems.remaining_engineering: Complete expanded RTL and selected receiver timing models, then source-bound pin allocation/fit and measured signal integrity

subsystems.name: Host and local I/O transports
subsystems.required_method: Sweep clock, CS framing, duty cycle and turnaround with independent clocks, latency, jitter, corruption, stale/repeated/partial frames and all lanes active
subsystems.remaining_engineering: Actual CNC3 RTL/HAL transport absent; final routed paths and package timing needed

subsystems.name: 1 kHz target with 700 us completion budget
subsystems.required_method: Actual LinuxCNC/CNC3 HAL through Verilated actual FPGA; record complete exchange age and missed deadlines under display/CAD/storage/network/ESP load
subsystems.remaining_engineering: Historical CNC1 six/two evidence is separate; host simulation cannot qualify target PREEMPT_RT jitter

subsystems.name: 24 DI plus alarms and fast inputs
subsystems.required_method: Source-extracted thresholds/delay/hysteresis at voltage, tolerance and temperature corners; NPN/PNP profiles only where the actual circuit supports them
subsystems.remaining_engineering: Source26 block-specific models and declared corner ranges needed

subsystems.name: Probe, toolsetter and frequency capture
subsystems.required_method: Asynchronous phase/rate sweep with full motion/IO; exact capture-cycle, synchronizer delay, debounce, loss/validity and inhibit interactions
subsystems.remaining_engineering: Full FPGA endpoint/event transport and source-bound input models needed

subsystems.name: 16 TPS274C65ASRHAR outputs
subsystems.required_method: DC/pulsed/inductive loads, open load, shorts, supply faults and simultaneous banks; current sense tolerance, channel limit and disable propagation
subsystems.remaining_engineering: 0.5 A/channel and 2 A/four-channel bank are design limits, not demonstrated ampacity; accurate protected-switch models needed

subsystems.name: Power entry and actual rail distribution
subsystems.required_method: Per-source converter/load models; ramp order/rate, dip duration/depth, partial power, backfeed, hot/cold tolerance, inrush, short/fuse recovery and remote load steps
subsystems.remaining_engineering: Final routes/copper/cooling and validated component models needed; net names are not fabricated voltage limits

subsystems.name: Independent permission removal <=20 ms
subsystems.required_method: Actual dual watchdog/reset/latch/driver chain across tolerance/voltage/temperature; clock halt, link loss, reset, brownout and stuck progress; no autonomous restart
subsystems.remaining_engineering: Source27 known slow-input/reset corrections must be integrated and routed before full-circuit claim; 14.12402 ms conditional budget is not measured bound

subsystems.name: Analog inputs and process/0-10 V outputs
subsystems.required_method: Gain/offset/reference/divider/ADC/DAC errors, input impedance, saturation, settling, crosstalk, open/short sensor, temperature corners and declared-distribution Monte Carlo
subsystems.remaining_engineering: Actual circuit models, calibration policy and complete error budget needed; no accuracy specification invented

subsystems.name: CAN, RS-485, ESP and expansion
subsystems.required_method: Concurrent traffic, bus contention/loss, supply isolation, stale identity/data, disconnect/reconnect and missing modules with permissions safe
subsystems.remaining_engineering: Existing isolated host/IOL1/ESP tests are partial evidence, not complete physical bus qualification

subsystems.name: FPGA, converters, output banks and enclosure
subsystems.required_method: Source-bound power estimator, switching activity, copper loss and thermal model under simultaneous maximum allowed loads at specified ambient/airflow
subsystems.remaining_engineering: Vendor power estimator, final copper, enclosure/cooling and component dissipation models missing

subsystems.name: STEP/DIR cable and high-speed traces
subsystems.required_method: Actual extracted layer/length/via/return geometry, transmitter/receiver and cable/load models at corner edge rates; reflection, crosstalk and timing margins
subsystems.remaining_engineering: Board still has 3528 required joins; no cable-length or high-speed electrical rating before routed stackup and models

subsystems.name: All features active together
subsystems.required_method: Twelve motors, four base and any qualified expansion encoders, 24 DI, 16 DO within bank limits, analog, CAN/RS-485, display rendering/CAD, network/storage and ESP radios
subsystems.remaining_engineering: No assembled full virtual controller yet; report servo/SPI/resource/power/temperature denominators together

subsystems.name: Blank setup through fault and recovery
subsystems.required_method: Detect compute, offline provision, validated hardware profile, CAD or no-CAD setup, kinematics, wiring, home/jog/G-code, injected fault, deterministic diagnosis/recovery through shared UI/CLI service
subsystems.remaining_engineering: File-only configuration/host tests are not complete UX acceptance; unsupported machine types remain explicitly unavailable

required_assertions: fault detected with valid time source
covered output permissions removed within specified electrical bound
no new motion pulses after declared inhibit propagation
actual emitted position and homing validity handled
fault_injection.randomized_runs: Seeded repeatable thousands of combinations and long-duration runs after actual integration; retain failing seeds/traces. No claim that overnight runs have occurred.
